fields.Category: Martial ranged weapon · Very Rare · Requires attunement
fields.Damage: 1d8 Force + Dexterity modifier + 1. Arrow of Restraint replaces all damage.
fields.Attack bonus: +1 plus Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus if proficient.
fields.Range: 150/600 feet for attacks. Transport and Ladder each reach 60 feet.
fields.Activation: Make a ranged attack, or take a Magic action for Transport or Ladder.
fields.Energy arrows: The bow creates an arrow when you draw it. It disappears after a hit or miss. Until then it sheds Bright Light for 20 feet and Dim Light for 20 more.
fields.Arrow of Restraint: Choose before attacking a creature. On a hit, deal no damage. A failed DC 15 Strength save Restrains it for 1 minute. The creature can take an action to end the effect with a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check.
fields.Arrow of Transport: Choose a visible willing creature of Medium size or smaller, or an unworn and uncarried object that fits in a 5-foot Cube. Teleport it to a visible unoccupied space within 10 feet of you.
fields.Energy Ladder: Fire at a wall within 60 feet to create a ladder of glowing rungs up to 60 feet long. It disappears after 1 minute.

fields.Category: Simple melee weapon · Very Rare · Requires attunement
fields.Damage: 1d8 Bludgeoning + Strength modifier. A hit adds 1d8 Thunder to a creature or 3d8 Thunder to an unworn and uncarried object.
fields.Attack bonus: Strength modifier plus Proficiency Bonus if proficient. While attuned, your Strength is at least 20.
fields.Range: 5 feet melee. Clap is a 30-foot Cone. Earthquake has a 50-foot radius centered on the impact.
fields.Activation: Attack normally, or take a Magic action and strike a hard surface for Clap or the ground for Earthquake.
fields.Clap of Thunder: Audible to 300 feet. Creatures in the cone fall Prone on a failed DC 15 Strength save. Nonmagical objects that are neither worn nor carried take 3d8 Thunder damage.
fields.Earthquake: Grounded structures take 50 Bludgeoning damage. Grounded creatures fall Prone on a failed DC 20 Dexterity save. A grounded creature concentrating also makes a DC 20 Constitution save or loses Concentration.
fields.Fissure: You may open a fissure 30 feet deep and 10 feet wide within the area. Creatures on it fall in on a failed DC 20 Dexterity save or move with its edge on a success. Structures on it collapse into the fissure.
fields.Recharge: Earthquake recharges at dawn. Clap of Thunder has no stated recharge.

fields.Damage: 1d6 Bludgeoning + Strength modifier for a mace hit.

fields.Range: 5 feet melee. Summon Celestial has a 90-foot casting range.
fields.Activation: Attack normally, or hold the mace and take a Magic action to spend 1 charge and cast Summon Celestial.
fields.Duration: Concentration, up to 1 hour for Summon Celestial.
fields.Charges: 6 charges. Regain 1d6 expended charges at dawn.
